Class AbandonedShip

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.model.cards.Card
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.model.cards.AbandonedShip
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class AbandonedShip extends Card
Represents the "Abandoned Ship" encounter card.

Players in flight may be asked to send a required number of crew members in order to gain credits while delaying their flight.

    • removeCrew

      public void removeCrew(String playerName, ArrayList<Coordinates> crewToRemove)
      Processes the removal of crew tiles from the current player’s board. If the correct number of tiles is provided and removal succeeds, awards credits, moves the flight board backward, and ends the card event.
      Overrides:
      removeCrew in class Card
      Parameters:
      playerName - name of the player performing the removal
      crewToRemove - list of tile coordinates to remove

    • choice

      public void choice(String playerName, boolean choice)
      Handles the player’s yes/no choice to send crew. If accepted, prompts the view to ask for crew coordinates; otherwise proceeds to the next player.
      Overrides:
      choice in class Card
      Parameters:
      playerName - name of the player making the choice
      choice - true to send crew, false to skip

    • nextPlayer

      public void nextPlayer()
      Advances to the next in-flight player who is eligible to respond to this card. Skips disconnected players and those without sufficient crew. Ends the event if all players have been considered.
